demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Volatility in cotton prices continues, with both cotton and yarn prices experiencing wide fluctuations.
- Global economic uncertainty, evolving tariff conditions, and changing climatic conditions adversely affect cotton crop yields, cotton price volatility, and availability of high-quality cotton.
- Government exempted import duty on cotton from Oct to Dec 2025, giving the company a breather on the procurement front.
- The India-UK Free Trade Agreement (signed May 2025) has opened new export opportunities for the textile industry.
- The India-Europe Free Trade Agreement (signed January 2026) marks a strategic breakthrough in India's global trade.
- Company expects Government support for the spinning industry via favourable textile policies and incentives.
- Company expects to continue performing well in the domestic market.
- Company is receiving moderate volume of orders for value-added counts.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company's modernization of spinning mills is expected to drive top-line growth and protect margins during the current year. Capacity utilisation was in the range of 90% during FY25-26 due to uncertainties in off-take. No named capital-expenditure project or capacity-addition plan with a commissioning timeline is disclosed in this bundle.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- technology: Value-added yarn portfolio (Mercerized, Mélange, Core Yarn) commands better customer appreciation than commodity counts — evidence: 'Company's quality of yarn in value added segment has been well appreciated by the customers and the Company is receiving moderate volume of orders for value added counts'
- cost position: Captive wind and solar power reduces exposure to grid power cost volatility — evidence: 'Power generated from green energy source namely Wind mill and Solar power to the extent of 322.98 lakhs Kilo Watt Units have subscribed to the overall power requirements for the manufacture of yarn and this has enabled to sustain the power cost per unit' — against it: 'even though solar power plant was available fully, the power generated could be used only to the extent of yarn production capacity usage'

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Volatility in cotton prices continues, with both cotton and yarn prices experiencing wide fluctuations, adversely affecting margins of yarn spinners across India.
- Even though there was some correction in cotton prices, the decline in yarn prices was much sharper, resulting in wider price variations that adversely affected margins.
- Global economic uncertainty, evolving tariff conditions, and US tariff uncertainty amid the west Asia war crisis have affected exports across Indian companies.
- Changing climatic conditions adversely affect cotton crop yields, contributing to cotton price volatility and constraints on availability of high-quality cotton.
- Constraints on the availability of high-quality cotton introduce unpredictability that the Company must monitor and manage.
- Capacity utilisation was in the range of 90% during FY25-26 due to uncertainties in off-take that prevailed for quite some time.
- Falling demand for commodity counts is a risk the Company seeks to mitigate through a shift to value-added and customized yarn counts.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening product portfolio with more value-added and customized yarn counts such as Mercerized Yarn, Mélange Yarn, and Core Yarn to mitigate the impact of falling demand for commodity counts.
- Modernization of spinning mills expected to drive top-line growth and protect margins.
- Continuing implementation of cost-saving measures including power cost reduction from green energy sources.
- Strategically shifting focus towards more value-added counts and importing higher-quality cotton when prices were reasonable, to enable competitive pricing.
- Initiatives towards sustainable manufacturing practices including water reuse, zero-liquid-discharge systems, and bio-treatment of wastewater for recycling.
